messages:
ivy (Billing): Quick flag — NimbusCore INV-2026-1220 (USD 1,880) is 12 days past due. Card on file returned error 'card_expired'. Customer emailed their finance lead saying new card will be provisioned but asked for a 7-day hold and waiver of late fee.
marc (FinOps): For <$2k we can generally waive fees up to $50 without exec. Do we know if they have past delinquencies?
jo (Collections): Customer has one prior 30d late from Q1 but no chronic history. Standard playbook: 7-day grace + single auto-retry on day 3, require card update and signed payment ack. If they don't update, escalate to soft suspension.
tom (AE): I'm on the thread with the customer; they said treasury is on PTO until Monday. They asked that we avoid blocking their dev envs. They offered to add card from their mobile app tomorrow AM.
ivy (Billing): Proposed: apply one-time waiver of $40 late fee, set dunning pause for 7 days, add note requiring card update by 72h. If card is added, charge full balance and remove provisional waiver. If not, resume dunning.
marc (FinOps): Approve $40 waiver. Finance wants the concession recorded in AR notes and included in next AR summary. Tag GL: 4302-WAIVER. Also require acknowledgment in the signed payment ack.
jo (Collections): I'll prepare the short payment ack and set auto-retry at 72h. Also will add escalation to Collections if update not received by 72h.
billing-bot: System: invoice INV-2026-1220 status set to "grace_hold" by ivy (Billing) at 2198000200.
ivy (Billing): Tom please confirm with customer that updating card by tomorrow triggers immediate capture. I'll post the payment link now.
tom (AE): Confirmed with customer; they said they'll update by 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll follow up if not.
marc (FinOps): One more ask: include this concession in weekly AR memo so leadership sees small service concession.
ivy (Billing): Done. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
